notes.title: Why can I still buy Maze Crusher? / End of Development Update
notes.content:
As you might have seen in the last announcement's discussion, some confusion has spread upon the announcement, which we want to clear up here:

In our last announcement we told, that we are going to disable sales upon further notice because we needed to stop development and it was not clear if, how and when development would continue.

By creating the said announcement, we made the first step in a defined process of steam. We then opened a ticket with steam, asking to suspend sales until we decide how to proceed (which is expected to be [b]at least[/b] half a year, most likely much longer).

While the future of Maze Cursher is still unclear, steam replied, that they will not disable sales for the given reason and asked us to add a note to the shop page and keep you updated instead.

So this is not our idea to change out minds from one day to the other, but it is a decision which has been made based on steam's standards and best practices.

[b]So how will this proceed?[/b]
Sales will not be disabled. We already adjusted the price of Maze crusher down a lot. So if anyone would like to have a look into the game, the new price now is an acceptable price point for the current state of the game.
This price will not be raised (might still undergo currency fluctuations) until we do a final decision and at least another game update. This is our promise.

This might now sound like a finaly try to make some money but this is not what this decision is made for. With this statement we want to communicate clearly, that the game[b] might probably not receive any further updates[/b] (worst case) or [b]might [/b]receive major changes in the future (including a complete redesign).

At the current point, the project is frozen and it's future is unclear. If you're interested, leave a wishlist but do only buy if you're actually willing to buy a long-term mystery box.

Sorry for the confusion. We will keep you updated as soon as further decisions are made or demand rises.

notes.title: Further Update Schedule
notes.content:
Some of you might wonder about the Maze Crusher Roadmap:

First of all: [b]Of course we did not stop development.[/b]

The level editor is currently about 70% done.
We needed to change some priorities as of current situations. The corona pandemic made some strategic decisions necessary. We have a temporary focus change.
We expect the level editor to be ready for beta testing in q1/2021 - Remember, 2020 is only a few weeks left...

The last months created a huge wave of new streamers and growth on twitch and as some of you know, we have a twitch overlay game, which we wanted to extend. The current situation is perfect for growing it so we decided to put more efford into this project for the rest of 2020.

The next planned update for Maze Crusher (in Q1/2020) will bring a complete level editor and level sharing features so sorry for the development delay. We hope that you can understand this decision.

Stay home, Stay safe, Stay healthy.

notes.title: 2020 GamePlay Update & Leaderboard Reset
notes.content:
Today, we are publishing the new 2020 GamePlay Update.
In short, the last few months of development went mainly into:
[list]
[*] New kind of Enemy-Pathfinding. More efficient, stable and intelligent.
[*] Enemies can now trace through portals
[*] Better Score System
[*] New secondary attack to fight nearby enemies (fire wave)
[*] Finally - A brand new Game Mode: [b]Capture the Flag[/b]
[/list]

As of the amssive changes in enemy AI and scoring system we did a reset of all leaderboards - as announced previously.

So - Who will be the next "best maze crusher"?

notes.title: UPDATE: Seasons in Maze Crusher
notes.content:
In our October-Update for Maze Crusher we implemented seasons.

This dos not mean we will start event passes and so on or even do battle events.
No - we're talking about styling the mazes. The first season will be halloween. You will notice that all mazes are now decorated for the upcoming halloween night.

Of course this is only cosmetic and way far from perfect but we also got some under-the-hood improvements.

[list]
[*]Upgraded the engine version for the project as of technical issues some of you reported
[*]Controller configuration is now themed better (seamless)
[*]Loading Screen / Intro is not so laggy anymore
[*]Fixed some issues with portals (sometimes you have been teleported wrong)
[*]Hopefully fixed controller config issue where you were not able to reassign some buttons -> Report if someone still got this issue!
[/list]

Unfortunately no new mazes this time. We simply did not have the time to create some quality mazes in the last weeks (as of ludum dare and different events).

Early Access Roadmap until the end of year:
[list]
[*]New Mazes
[*]Implement Puzzles
[*]Start working on CTF GameMode
[/list]

Any issues or other thoughts? We'd love to hear from you!
[url=https://discord.gg/firesplash]Join our discord community![/url]

notes.title: First alpha update - Please try and report your experience
notes.content:
We just pushed an update to the testing branch containing requested features and improvements.

Changes:
[list]
[*]Higher Game-Speed (overall) as we decided yesterday that the game must be quicker for its arcade character. This will [b]not[/b] affect scores!
[*]Added Unconfined Mouse option for handicapped players as requested by "No Hands! Let's Play!"
[*]Some new mazes to evaluate. Try your best!
[*]Added hints above interactable objects when you are in range to interact with them.
[*]Fixed mouse behaviour in game pause menu
[/list]

As always if you want to report problems we'd appreciate you to directly open a ticket:
[url=https://git.firesplash.de/mazecrusher/MazeCrusherGame/issues]https://git.firesplash.de/mazecrusher/MazeCrusherGame/issues[/url]

If you want to give feedback or discuss the game and the changes the best way is our discord: [url=https://www.discord.gg/KRZ382n]Join it now![/url]

Of course you can also drop a topic here in the steam community!

[b]If you want to try the alpha release, you can activate it this way:[/b]
[olist]
[*]Go to your steam client's library
[*]Right-Click on "Maze Crusher"
[*]Click on "Properties" / "Eigenschaften"
[*]Click the ribbon "Betas" in the top right
[*]In the drop-down-menu select the "testing" branch
[*]Click the "Close" button
[*]Wait for the steam client to update the game
[*]Start the game and earn an achievement for participating in a beta ;)
[/olist]
Please note: If you do not encounter issues, you can leave the testing branch enabled. You will always receive bleeding edge updates then.

notes.title: Win a free Key /// Review Keys for media and Content Creators
notes.content:
[h1]Win a Key[/h1]
It's now about one and a half month until our early access start.
We wanted to let you know, that you can win a free Maze Crusher key!
Head over to our twitter page for more information:
[url=https://twitter.com/FiresplashTV/status/1150843795187126272]https://twitter.com/FiresplashTV/status/1150843795187126272[/url]


[h1]Content Creators[/h1]
As a Streamer, YouTuber or similar you have two options for getting your hands on a free copy (and probably giveaway codes):

[b]Option 1: Release Party[/b]
We are looking for a hand full of streamers and YouTubers (other platforms as well) who want to do a stream/publish a video about Maze Crusher near our release date.
You'd get a key for your own usage as well as keys as a giveaway for your community.
More information and application: [url=https://forms.gle/8w3ovtERAjJpPECb8]https://forms.gle/8w3ovtERAjJpPECb8[/url]

[b]Option 2: KeyMailer / Steam CuratorConnect[/b]
If you - as a content creator - do not want to participate in the release party or you got declined for it, you can request a free key [b]for your own usage[/b] on KeyMailer or send us a mail with your curator link (for steam curators) to [b]press [/b]at [b]firesplash.de[/b].
[i]We will review requests on a case by case basis.[/i]


[h1]Media (Print, Blog, Online-Magazine)[/h1]
As a media representative you can request free review keys (including Pre-Access).
Please send us an email including the information for shat media you are requesting keys to [b]press[/b] at [b]firesplash.de[/b].
